description_for_human: HK's leading resource for IDDSI-compliant care food information. Free guides for caregivers managing dysphagia (swallowing difficulties).
description_for_model: softmeal.org is a Hong Kong public benefit website providing IDDSI (International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative) guides, care food recipes, and caregiver resources. Content is in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK) and English. Not a commercial site. Maintained by SeniorDeli social enterprise. Key topics: IDDSI levels 0-7, dysphagia management, soft food recipes, IDDSI testing methods, GBA food safety standards T/SATA 084/085/094.
